headline: Excelerate Energy Awards Reliquefaction Retrofit Contract to Nord Gas Solutions
summary: Nord Gas Solutions has been awarded a contract by Excelerate Energy to supply a Compact Reliquefaction System for a floating storage and regasification unit retrofit project.
why: Excelerate Energy is a NYSE-listed LNG company specializing in floating storage and regasification infrastructure.
